question: Will more beer be sold at Oktoberfest 2026 in Munich than at Oktoberfest 2025 (~6.5 million liters)?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the official Oktoberfest 2026 figures published by the City of Munich (muenchen.de) state that total beer sold by tent operators exceeded exactly 6.5 million liters.
- "No": Wins if the official Oktoberfest 2026 figures published by the City of Munich (muenchen.de) state that total beer sold by tent operators was 6.5 million liters or fewer.

Clarifications:
- Beer volume is measured in liters as reported by Oktoberfest tent operators in the City of Munich's official post-festival figures (including preliminary estimates published on muenchen.de); the threshold is exactly 6.5 million liters — the verified 2026 figure must strictly exceed 6.5 million liters for "Yes" to win. The '~6.5 million liters' reference in the question title reflects the approximate 2025 benchmark; the precise resolution cutoff is 6.5 million liters.
